value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for 1 (walking) to 3 year olds with a parent, Term 1 Sept 14 to Nov 1 and Term 2 Nov 2 to Dec 20 - their site says. I could not pin down the day or the price, and Term 1 registration opened July 22 at 8am online. I'll keep watching and text you when I have them.
